ambiguities.text: The specification states store upgrades 'may occur before DENEB_FORK_EPOCH' but does not specify the earliest permissible epoch for upgrade.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume upgrade can happen at any time before DENEB_FORK_EPOCH, as the zero-initialized blob fields have no semantic impact on pre-Deneb data.

implicit_assumptions.description: Zero-initialized blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas fields are assumed to be semantically neutral for pre-Deneb headers and will not affect validation logic.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If validation logic checks these fields before the fork epoch, zero values could cause false rejections of valid pre-Deneb headers.

implicit_assumptions.description: All light client implementations will upgrade their stores before attempting to process Deneb-era data.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Clients that fail to upgrade would be unable to verify post-Deneb light client updates and could fall out of sync.
